name: marineteam/video-portal
description: Self-hosted video portal and media library. Installs on shared hosting via a web wizard.
_comment_dependencies: Kept deliberately tiny. vendor/ ships inside the release ZIP because target hosts have no Composer, which means every dependency can only be security-patched by cutting a whole new app release. Outbound HTTP is hand-rolled on curl (core/Support/Http.php) rather than pulling in Guzzle for what amounts to 'POST some JSON'. web-push arrives in phase 5 with the notifications feature, not before.
